description: Canonical model-callable tool definitions. Runtime handlers are bound by tool name in Python.

function.name: list_files
function.description: List project files under a directory.

function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a UTF-8 project file in line-based chunks. ALWAYS supply all three arguments: path, offset, and limit. For the first chunk use offset=0. offset is a zero-based line offset and limit is the number of lines to return (1-500). If the result shows More content available, make another read_file call with the SAME path and limit and offset set to the exact next_offset shown. Never repeat an earlier offset unless the user explicitly asks you to reread it.

function.name: search_files
function.description: Search for a case-insensitive text string. path may be either a single project file (for example agent.py) or a project directory (for example modules). Use a file path when searching one known file; use a directory for recursive search.

function.name: edit_file
function.description: Propose replacing a project file. The user must approve the displayed diff.

function.name: patch_file
function.description: Make a targeted section edit by replacing one exact, unique text block. Prefer this over regenerating an entire file.

function.name: run_checks
function.description: Run an approved Python test or syntax check.

function.name: replace_lines
function.description: Replace a 1-based inclusive line range in a project file. Prefer this when exact patch text is failing due to indentation or whitespace. Read the file first, use its actual line numbers, and provide the complete replacement text for the selected range. The user must approve the displayed diff.

function.name: get_file_outline
function.description: For a Python file, return top-level imports, classes, functions and methods with line ranges. Use this before reading a large source file.

function.name: find_symbol
function.description: Find Python definitions of a class, function, method or assignment by exact name under a project file or directory.

function.name: find_references
function.description: Search project text files for usages of a symbol. This is a textual search, not a semantic language-server reference search.

function.name: verify_changes
function.description: Run Python compileall and optionally unittest or pytest in a project directory. Requires user approval and uses configured time/output limits.

function.name: inspect_test_failure
function.description: Extract likely failing test names, assertion errors, tracebacks and relevant context from supplied test output. Does not execute tests.

function.name: get_project_map
function.description: Summarize project directories, file types and likely Python entry points. Skips generated and dependency directories.

function.name: get_test_map
function.description: List test files and heuristically map their names to likely source modules. Treat mappings as hints, not proof.

function.name: update_task_plan
function.description: Create or update the visible task checklist. Supply the complete current list; statuses are pending, in_progress, completed, or blocked. Update it as work progresses.

function.name: os_command
function.description: Run a tightly allowlisted operating-system command in the project. This is NOT a shell: use executable=git with read-only subcommands (status, diff, log, branch --show-current, rev-parse, show), or executable=python3 with -m pytest, -m unittest discover, or -m compileall. No pipes, redirects, shell expansion, scripts, arbitrary executables, network commands, or privileged operations are supported.
